hadi-march/ui#Rating.name: Rating
hadi-march/ui#Rating.doc: Star rating (radio group; ← → change): `<Rating bind:value={$stars} />`, `<Rating value={4.5} readonly />`

props.name: icon
props.doc: The empty mark instead of the star outline: an icon of hadi-march/icons, or `(n) => node` for your own drawing.

props.name: iconOn
props.doc: The filled mark instead of the filled star (same forms as `icon`).

props.name: starLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of a mark: `(n, max) => text` (default "3 of 5").

props.name: animate
props.doc: `false`: no hover growth and no fade between empty and filled.

hadi-march/ui#Rating.tr: Yıldız derecelendirme (radyo grubu; ← → değiştirir): `<Rating bind:value={$stars} />`, `<Rating value={4.5} readonly />`

hadi-march/ui#ReactionPicker.name: ReactionPicker

props.name: selected
props.doc: The current reaction (pressed).

props.name: layout
props.doc: row: a pill (reactions) · grid: a panel (emoji keyboard). Default row.

props.name: onMore
props.doc: A "+" at the end of a row (more emoji).

props.name: pop
props.doc: Pop-in animation when it appears. Default true.

props.name: emojiLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of an emoji button: `(emoji) => "Heart"`. Default: the emoji itself.

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the "+" button. Default "More emoji".

props.name: moreIcon
props.doc: Your own content for the "+" button.

hadi-march/ui#ReactionPicker.tr: `<ReactionPicker selected={msg.myReaction} onPick={(e) => react(msg, e)} />` — tepki seçici.

hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.name: readingProgressFeature
hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.doc: A thin bar at the top that fills as the page is read (keeps working with reduced motion: it is information).
hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.valueType: (opts?: { color?: string; height?: number; label?: string; } | undefined) => LayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: sayfanın üstünde okuma ilerleme çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#RecordListEditor.name: RecordListEditor
hadi-march/ui#RecordListEditor.doc: Edit a list of records with a schema: add, remove, reorder, validate each row.

props.name: fields
props.doc: Sub-schema: a spec object or a schema.

props.name: blank
props.doc: New-row values (or a function returning them).

props.name: removable
props.doc: Default true.

props.name: sortable
props.doc: Default true.

props.name: cols
props.doc: Fields per line (default: number of fields, max 6).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#RecordListEditor.tr: Şemalı kayıt listesini düzenler: ekle, sil, yeniden sırala, her satırı doğrula.

hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.name: registerCommands
hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.doc: Register palette commands: [{ id, title, run, href, group, keywords, icon, shortcut, hidden, can }] or action() objects. `list` may be an accessor. Removed with the current owner, or call the returned function.
hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.signature: const registerCommands: (list: MaybeFn<readonly Command[] | null | undefined>) => (() => void)
hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.tr: Palet komutlarını kaydeder: [{ id, title, run, href, group, keywords, icon, shortcut, hidden, can }] ya da action() nesneleri. `list` bir erişimci olabilir. Mevcut sahip ile kaldırılır ya da dönen işlevi çağırın.

hadi-march/ui#registerInput.name: registerInput
hadi-march/ui#registerInput.doc: Register (or replace) the input used for a field type or `control` name.
hadi-march/ui#registerInput.signature: function registerInput(type: string, Component: InputComponent | null): void
hadi-march/ui#registerInput.tr: Bir alan türü ya da `control` adı için kullanılan girdiyi kaydeder (veya değiştirir).

hadi-march/ui#registerPages.name: registerPages
hadi-march/ui#registerPages.doc: Make pages ({ id, title, href, group, keywords, icon }) searchable. `list` may be an accessor. Returns unregister.
hadi-march/ui#registerPages.signature: const registerPages: (list: MaybeFn<readonly PageEntry[] | null | undefined>) => (() => void)
hadi-march/ui#registerPages.tr: Sayfaları ({ id, title, href, group, keywords, icon }) aranabilir yapar. `list` bir erişimci olabilir. Kaydı kaldıran işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#registerThemes.name: registerThemes
hadi-march/ui#registerThemes.doc: Offer extra themes: `registerThemes([{ id: "hadi-marka", name: "HADİ", href: "themes/hadi-marka.css" }])` (CSS made with themeCss()).
hadi-march/ui#registerThemes.tr: Ek temalar sunar: `registerThemes([{ id: "hadiMarka", name: "HADİ", href: "/themes/hadi-marka.css" }])` (CSS themeCss() ile üretilir).

hadi-march/ui#removeAt.name: removeAt
hadi-march/ui#removeAt.signature: function removeAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath): unknown

hadi-march/ui#renameAt.name: renameAt
hadi-march/ui#renameAt.doc: Rename an object key in place (the order of the keys is kept).
hadi-march/ui#renameAt.signature: function renameAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, to: string): unknown
hadi-march/ui#renameAt.tr: Bir nesne anahtarını yerinde yeniden adlandırır (anahtar sırası korunur).

hadi-march/ui#renderFields.name: renderFields
hadi-march/ui#renderFields.doc: Render the active schema fields (`names` or all), honouring `when`, `hidden` and layout.
hadi-march/ui#renderFields.signature: function renderFields<V>(form: FormController<V>, names?: readonly FieldName<V>[] | null, layout?: FieldsLayout): Element
hadi-march/ui#renderFields.tr: Etkin şema alanlarını (`names` ya da tümü) çizer; `when`, `hidden` ve yerleşime uyar.

hadi-march/ui#renderItem.name: renderItem
hadi-march/ui#renderItem.doc: Draw one menu entry: a separator (Divider) or a ListRow (a router link with `href`, a button otherwise). ContextMenu reuses it.
hadi-march/ui#renderItem.signature: function renderItem(it: MenuItem, args: unknown[], close: (refocus: boolean) => void): unknown
hadi-march/ui#renderItem.tr: Tek bir menü girdisini çizer: ayraç, action() düğmesi, yönlendirici bağlantısı ya da düz düğme. ContextMenu da kullanır.

hadi-march/ui#ReplyQuote.name: ReplyQuote
hadi-march/ui#ReplyQuote.doc: `<ReplyQuote name="Deniz" text="See you at 8?" />`, `<ReplyQuote name="Replying to Deniz" text={m.text} lines={1} onClose={cancel} />`

props.name: name
props.doc: The first line: who is quoted ("Deniz"), or your own line ("Replying to Deniz").

props.name: text
props.doc: The quoted text.

props.name: lines
props.doc: Lines of the text kept (default 2; 1 for a preview above a field; 0 shows all).

props.name: variant
props.doc: "soft" (default: a tinted box) or "inverse" (inside a coloured bubble: darker box, bar and name in the text colour).

props.name: bar
props.doc: The bar at the start edge (default true).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Shows the cancel button and runs on it.

props.name: close
props.doc: The cancel button: shown when `onClose` is given (default), false for none, or your own icon for it.

props.name: closeLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the cancel button (default "Cancel reply").

props.name: trail
props.doc: After the text, before the cancel button: a thumbnail of a quoted photo, your own control.

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Makes the quote a button (jump to the quoted message).

hadi-march/ui#ReplyQuote.tr: Yanıtlanan mesajın alıntısı: ad ve kısaltılmış metin renkli çubuğun arkasında; balonda alıntı, yazma alanının üstünde vazgeç düğmeli önizleme: `<ReplyQuote name="Deniz" text={m.text} onClose={cancel} />`.

hadi-march/ui#ResizeHandle.name: ResizeHandle
hadi-march/ui#ResizeHandle.doc: `<ResizeHandle value={() => $w} set={(w) => $w = w} min={160} max={480} reset={() => $w = 240} label="Sidebar width" />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The current size: a number (a live JSX value) or an accessor. With `set` the handle is a full separator.

props.name: edge
props.doc: Edge or corner of the parent (default "end"). start / top grow the thing toward the start (`invert`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Resize").

props.name: line
props.doc: The line: "hover" (default: on hover, focus and drag), "always", or "none".

props.name: grip
props.doc: A visible grip in the middle: true (a short bar), or your own node.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: No pointer, no focus.

props.name: onStep
props.type: ((dx: number, dy: number, e: KeyboardEvent) => void) | undefined
props.doc: Without `value` + `set`: arrow keys call this with a step in px along x (RTL mirrored) and y; Shift = 4 steps.

props.name: ref
props.doc: Called with the element.

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size units per pointer pixel (default 1); a percent split passes `() => 100 / container width`.

props.name: set
props.doc: Apply a size, already clamped to min / max; `done` is true when a gesture ends (save it then).

props.name: step
props.doc: Keyboard step (default 16); Shift and Page keys move `bigStep` (default 4 × step).

props.name: axis
props.doc: "inline" (default): the handle moves left / right and grows toward the inline end; "block": up / down.

props.name: invert
props.doc: The thing grows toward the inline start / block start (a panel on the end edge).

props.name: reset
props.doc: Enter and double click (default: none).

hadi-march/ui#ResizeHandle.tr: resize-handle davranışının hazır öğesi: kenarda ya da köşede tek görünümlü tutamaç; `value` + `set` ile tam ayırıcı (sürükleme, ok tuşları, ARIA), onlarsız yalın tutamaç. `<ResizeHandle value={() => $w} set={(w) => $w = w} />`.

hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.name: resolveColor
hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.doc: A theme token ("brand-orange", "cat-3", "primary") → the color it has under `el` (a CSS color passes through).
hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.signature: function resolveColor(token: string, el?: Element | null): string
hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.tr: Bir tema belirteci ("brand-orange", "cat-3", "primary") → `el` altında sahip olduğu renk (CSS rengi aynen geçer).

hadi-march/ui#resolvedTheme.name: resolvedTheme
hadi-march/ui#resolvedTheme.doc: Effective theme after resolving "system" with prefers-color-scheme (not reactive to OS changes).
hadi-march/ui#resolvedTheme.tr: "system" değerinin prefers-color-scheme ile çözülmesinden sonraki geçerli tema (işletim sistemi değişikliklerine tepki vermez).

hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.name: resolveFeatures
hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.doc: The features a prop stands for, over `def` (a config merges by name, a list replaces, a function maps).
hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.signature: function resolveFeatures(def: FeaturesProp | undefined, own: FeaturesProp | undefined): LayoutFeature[]
hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.tr: Bir `features` değerinin karşılığı olan özellikler: yapılandırma ada göre birleşir, liste yerine geçer, işlev eşler.

hadi-march/ui#restyleAhead.name: restyleAhead
hadi-march/ui#restyleAhead.doc: Called by a theme setter before it changes anything for a new look (see setRestyleTransition's `prepare`).
hadi-march/ui#restyleAhead.tr: Bir tema ayarlayıcısı, yeni görünüm için bir şey değiştirmeden önce bunu çağırır: kurulu geçişin `prepare`ı eski görünümü o anda alır.

hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.name: rgbToHsv
hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.doc: RGB(A) to HSV(A); `hue` keeps the previous hue for greys (no hue of their own).
hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.signature: function rgbToHsv(__0: Rgba, hue: number = 0): Hsva
hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.tr: RGB(A) → HSV(A); `hue`, griler için önceki tonu korur (kendi tonları yoktur).

hadi-march/ui#RichTextEditor.name: RichTextEditor
hadi-march/ui#RichTextEditor.doc: Rich text editor: `<RichTextEditor bind:value={$markdown} mentions={team} />`. The value is Markdown.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Toolbar items (default DEFAULT_TOOLS); false hides the toolbar (shortcuts still work).

props.name: mentions
props.type: readonly Mention[] | ((query: string) => readonly Mention[] | Promise<readonly Mention[]>) | undefined
props.doc: People for

props.name: emoji
props.doc: :emoji suggestions (default true; a list replaces the built-in set).

props.name: shortcuts
props.doc: Markdown shortcuts while typing (default true).

props.name: history
props.doc: Undo history to record into (default: the editor's own; pass undoStack() to share the app's).

props.name: rows
props.doc: Minimum height of the writing area in lines (default 6).

props.name: counter
props.doc: Word / character counter under the text (default true).

props.name: api
props.doc: Receives the editor API once mounted.

props.name: hint
props.doc: The "Type @ to mention, : for emoji" hint under the text (default true; `counter={false}` removes the whole foot).

props.name: toolIcons
props.doc: Own icon (any node or text) for a toolbar button: `{ bold: "B", link: <Icon of={chain} /> }`.

props.name: labels
props.type: { editor?: string; toolbar?: string; tools?: Partial<Record<Exclude<ToolName, "|">, string>>; link?: string; linkAddress?: string; linkHelp?: string; apply?: string; removeLink?: string; suggestions?: string; noMatches?: string; keepTyping?: string; hint?: string; count?: (words: number, characters: number) => string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; defaults are the translated ones. `tools` names the toolbar buttons, `count` writes the counter.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#RichTextEditor.tr: Zengin metin düzenleyicisi: `<RichTextEditor bind:value={$markdown} mentions={team} />`. Değer Markdown'dır.

hadi-march/ui#routeFocusFeature.name: routeFocusFeature
hadi-march/ui#routeFocusFeature.doc: After a route change: focus moves to the page (main) and the new title is read out; nothing moves on first load.
hadi-march/ui#routeFocusFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: sayfa değişince odağı yeni sayfanın başlığına taşır ve ekran okuyucuya duyurur.

hadi-march/ui#row.name: row
hadi-march/ui#row.doc: Children side by side: row([weight, child], …).
hadi-march/ui#row.tr: Hazır düzende yan yana duran çocuklar: `row([ağırlık, çocuk], …)`.

hadi-march/ui#RowTools.name: RowTools
hadi-march/ui#RowTools.doc: `<RowTools index={i} count={() => list().length} onUp={…} onDown={…} onRemove={…} />`, `<RowTools actions={["remove"]} onRemove={…} />`

props.name: actions
props.doc: Which tools, in this order (default: up, down, remove).

props.name: onAction
props.doc: One handler for every tool (called besides onUp / onDown / onRemove).

props.name: index
props.doc: Position of the row: "up" is off on the first row.

props.name: count
props.doc: Rows in the list: "down" is off on the last row.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Switch all tools off, or some: `{ remove: () => list().length <= 1 }`.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own names (default "Move up", "Move down", "Remove", group "Row tools"; translated).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Own icons: an icon, text, a node or `() => node` each (a node is copied for every row).

props.name: danger
props.doc: The remove tool in the danger colour.

hadi-march/ui#RowTools.tr: Düzenlenebilir listede satır araçları (yukarı, aşağı, sil); uçlarda kapanır: `<RowTools index={i} count={n} onUp={…} onDown={…} onRemove={…} />`

hadi-march/ui#sample.name: sample
hadi-march/ui#sample.doc: Every target's values at `t`: { logo: { x: 12, rotate: 30 }, … }.
hadi-march/ui#sample.signature: function sample(model: TimelineModel, t: number): Record<string, Partial<Record<TimelineProp, number>>>
hadi-march/ui#sample.tr: `t` anında her hedefin değerleri: { logo: { x: 12, rotate: 30 }, … }.

hadi-march/ui#sampleTrack.name: sampleTrack
hadi-march/ui#sampleTrack.doc: The value of a track at `t` ms.
hadi-march/ui#sampleTrack.signature: function sampleTrack(track: TimelineTrack, t: number): number

hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.name: schemaAt
hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.doc: The schema that applies at `p` (for hints and enum pickers).
hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.signature: function schemaAt(schema: JsonSchema | undefined, p: JsonPath): JsonSchema | undefined
hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.tr: `p` konumunda geçerli olan şema (ipuçları ve enum seçicileri için).

hadi-march/ui#score.name: score
hadi-march/ui#score.doc: Score `query` against an item's title (and keywords, weighted lower). 0 = no match; higher is better. Every query word must match somewhere. Exact prefixes beat word starts, beat substrings, beat typo matches.
hadi-march/ui#score.signature: function score(query: string, title: string, keywords: Keywords = ""): number
hadi-march/ui#score.tr: `query` değerini öğenin başlığına (daha az ağırlıkla anahtar sözcüklerine) göre puanlar: 0 eşleşme yok, yüksek daha iyi; önek > sözcük başı > alt dize > yazım hatası.

hadi-march/ui#ScrollToTop.name: ScrollToTop
hadi-march/ui#ScrollToTop.doc: A button that scrolls the page back to the top; hidden until the page is scrolled past `threshold`.

props.name: threshold
props.doc: Scrolled distance (px) after which the button shows. Default 320.

props.name: order
props.doc: Place in the page corner (lower = nearer the edge). Default 0.

props.name: inline
props.doc: Render in place instead of in the page corner.

props.name: target
props.doc: What to follow and scroll; default: the page — the window, or the app's main area when that is what scrolls. Boxes that scroll inside the page (a demo, a list, a code block) are never taken over.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name and tooltip (default: "Back to top", translated).

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon (default: an up arrow): your own node / icon.

props.name: motion
props.type: "pop" | "fade" | "slide" | "none" | false | ((el: HTMLElement, shown: boolean) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: How the button appears and leaves: "pop" (default), "fade", "slide", "none" / false, or `(el, shown) => …` (your own animation).

props.name: smooth
props.doc: Scroll back smoothly (default true); false jumps at once.

hadi-march/ui#ScrollToTop.tr: Sayfa aşağı kayınca görünen, tıklanınca yumuşakça başa döndüren düğme.

hadi-march/ui#scrollToTopFeature.name: scrollToTopFeature
hadi-march/ui#scrollToTopFeature.doc: Back-to-top button in a corner (default bottom-end): shows after scrolling down, scrolls back on the motion engine.
hadi-march/ui#scrollToTopFeature.valueType: (opts?: { threshold?: number; corner?: Corner; order?: number; label?: string; } | undefined) => LayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#scrollToTopFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: köşede başa dön düğmesi (eşik ayarlanabilir).

hadi-march/ui#SearchBox.name: SearchBox
hadi-march/ui#SearchBox.doc: Debounced search input with a clear button. `<SearchBox bind:value={$q} onSearch={(q) => …} debounce={250} shortcut />` `shortcut`: pressing "/" anywhere focuses it. `size="sm"`, `icon={false}`, `clear={false}`, `debounce={0}`.

props.name: value
props.doc: A signal (two-way), or a value / accessor to follow. `bind:value` works too.

props.name: onSearch
props.doc: The debounced value (also at once on Enter and on clear).

props.name: onInput
props.doc: Every keystroke, before the debounce.

props.name: debounce
props.doc: ms (default 250); 0: every keystroke is written at once.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: `true`: "/" focuses the box; or another combo. The hint is shown at the end of the field.

props.name: shortcutHint
props.doc: The shortcut hint: true (default, the `shortcut` combo), false (the key works, no hint), or another combo / text to show.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default: the placeholder, else "Search").

props.name: size
props.doc: md (default) or sm (toolbars, side panels).

props.name: variant
props.doc: "field" (default) or "plain": no border or ring (the input of a palette or a panel header).

props.name: icon
props.doc: The leading icon: true (default, a magnifier), false, or your own icon.

props.name: clear
props.doc: The clear button: true (default), false, or your own icon for it.

props.name: clearLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the clear button (default "Clear search").

props.name: inputClass
props.doc: Extra class on the input element (the host's own hook for it).

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: Called with the input element (focus it, measure it).

props.name: onKeyDown
props.doc: Keys of the input, before the box's own Escape / Enter; `preventDefault()` skips those.

props.name: controls
props.doc: Combobox: id of the list this box filters (sets role="combobox" and aria-controls).

props.name: activeDescendant
props.doc: Combobox: id of the highlighted option.

props.name: expanded
props.doc: Combobox: whether the list is shown (default true while `controls` is set).

hadi-march/ui#SearchBox.tr: Temizle düğmeli, geciktirmeli arama girdisi. `<SearchBox bind:value={$q} onSearch={(q) => …} debounce={250} shortcut />` `shortcut`: herhangi bir yerde "/" tuşuna basmak odaklar.

hadi-march/ui#Section.name: Section
hadi-march/ui#Section.doc: Titled block inside a page: `<Section title="Security" description="…" actions={[…]}>…</Section>`
hadi-march/ui#Section.tr: Sayfa içinde başlıklı blok: `<Section title="Security" description="…" actions={[…]}>…</Section>`

hadi-march/ui#SectionLabel.name: SectionLabel
hadi-march/ui#SectionLabel.doc: `<SectionLabel icon={star} count={3} actions={<IconButton size="sm" icon={plus} label="Add" />}>Favorites</SectionLabel>`

props.name: label
props.doc: The text (or pass children).

props.name: as
props.doc: Root element (default "div"): a heading level, "p", "legend", "li", "span".

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (IconDef, emoji, node) before the text.

props.name: count
props.doc: A number (or any node) after the text: how many items the group has.

props.name: actions
props.doc: The end side: a small button, a link.

props.name: upper
props.doc: Uppercase with wide tracking (default true); false keeps the text as written.

props.name: size
props.doc: sm: inside menus and dense panels (default); md: a little larger.

props.name: rule
props.doc: A thin rule after the text that fills the row.

hadi-march/ui#SectionLabel.tr: Panel içindeki grubun küçük başlığı (büyük harf, soluk): ikon, sayı ve sonda eylem yuvası. `<SectionLabel count={3}>Sık kullanılanlar</SectionLabel>`.

hadi-march/ui#Segmented.name: Segmented
hadi-march/ui#Segmented.doc: Segmented control (a compact single choice). Arrow keys move and select.

props.name: options
props.doc: `[value]` or `[{ value, label, icon, title, disabled }]` (see SegmentedOption); may be a function.

props.name: indicator
props.doc: How the chosen segment is marked: "fill" (default: it is raised in place) or "slide" (one thumb glides to it).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Segmented.tr: Bölmeli denetim (kompakt tekli seçim). Ok tuşları hareket ettirir ve seçer.

hadi-march/ui#Select.name: Select
hadi-march/ui#Select.doc: Native select. Props: options ([value] or [{value,label,disabled}], may be live), placeholder. Values keep their type.

props.name: options
props.doc: [value] or [{ value, label, disabled }]; may be live.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text of the empty first option; false: no empty option (a choice that is never empty, e.g. a language).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Select.tr: Yerel seçim kutusu. Prop'lar: options ([value] ya da [{value,label,disabled}], canlı olabilir), placeholder. Değerler türünü korur.

hadi-march/ui#setAccent.name: setAccent
hadi-march/ui#setAccent.doc: Recolor the app: a color token, or "primary" / null for the theme's own primary. Remembered across visits.
hadi-march/ui#setAccent.signature: function setAccent(token: ColorToken | null | undefined): ColorToken
hadi-march/ui#setAccent.tr: Uygulamayı yeniden renklendirir: bir renk belirteci ya da temanın kendi birincil rengi için "primary" / null. Ziyaretler arasında hatırlanır.

hadi-march/ui#setColorTheme.name: setColorTheme
hadi-march/ui#setColorTheme.doc: Switch the color theme (persisted under localStorage "m.colorTheme"); its stylesheet is loaded on demand.
hadi-march/ui#setColorTheme.tr: Renk temasını değiştirir (localStorage "m.colorTheme" altında saklanır); stil sayfası gerektiğinde yüklenir.

hadi-march/ui#setRestyleTransition.name: setRestyleTransition
hadi-march/ui#setRestyleTransition.doc: Put a transition around every page-wide restyle (setTheme, setColorTheme, setAccent): `(apply) => …` must call `apply` once. `null` removes it. `prepare`, when given, runs just before a setter changes anything for a new look (its controls show the new choice at once; the look itself may land later, a color theme once its stylesheet is in): the moment to take a picture of the old look. Returns a function that removes this one. `installThemeWave()` (hadi-march/motion) uses it to bring the new look in with a transition.
hadi-march/ui#setRestyleTransition.signature: function setRestyleTransition(fn: RestyleTransition | null, prepare?: () => void): () => void
hadi-march/ui#setRestyleTransition.tr: Sayfa genelindeki her yeniden boyamanın (setTheme, setColorTheme, setAccent) çevresine bir geçiş koyar: `(apply) => …` `apply`ı bir kez çağırmalıdır; `null` kaldırır. İsteğe bağlı `prepare` bir ayarlayıcı bir şey değiştirmeden hemen önce çalışır.

hadi-march/ui#setTheme.name: setTheme
hadi-march/ui#setTheme.doc: Set light, dark or system mode.
hadi-march/ui#setTheme.tr: Açık, koyu ya da sistem kipini ayarlar.

hadi-march/ui#setThemeBase.name: setThemeBase
hadi-march/ui#setThemeBase.doc: Where the built-in theme stylesheets live (default "themes/" under the app's root, on any route; `march build` copies them there).
hadi-march/ui#setThemeBase.tr: Yerleşik tema stil sayfalarının bulunduğu yer (varsayılan sayfaya göre "themes/"; `march build` bunları oraya kopyalar).

hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.name: shapesFor
hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.doc: Which shapes have a visible effect for a variant / kind (pickers disable the others).
hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.signature: function shapesFor(variant: ChoiceVariant | undefined, kind: "checkbox" | "radio"): ChoiceShape[]
hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.tr: Bir varyant / tür için hangi şekillerin görünür etkisi olduğunu verir (seçiciler diğerlerini devre dışı bırakır).

hadi-march/ui#shortcuts.name: shortcuts
hadi-march/ui#shortcuts.doc: Registered shortcuts that have a description (reactive): [{ combo, label, description, group }].
hadi-march/ui#shortcuts.tr: Açıklaması olan kayıtlı kısayollar (reaktif): [{ combo, label, description, group }].

hadi-march/ui#shortcutsFeature.name: shortcutsFeature
hadi-march/ui#shortcutsFeature.doc: "?" opens the list of every described shortcut; holding Alt shows shortcut badges on the page.
hadi-march/ui#shortcutsFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: ? tuşu kayıtlı kısayolların listesini açar.

hadi-march/ui#Skeleton.name: Skeleton
hadi-march/ui#Skeleton.doc: Placeholder while loading: `<Skeleton lines={3} />`, `<Skeleton block height="lg" />`, `<Skeleton shape="circle" />`.

props.name: shape
props.doc: "circle": one round shape (an avatar on its way); `height` picks its size (sm 2rem, md 2.5rem, lg 3.5rem).

props.name: shimmer
props.doc: The moving shimmer (default true); false keeps the shapes still.

props.name: shortLast
props.doc: The last of several lines is shorter (default true).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the lines (default "Loading", translated).

hadi-march/ui#Skeleton.tr: Yüklenirken yer tutucu: `<Skeleton lines={3} />`, `<Skeleton block height="lg" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Slider.name: Slider
hadi-march/ui#Slider.doc: Range slider with the current value shown. Props: min, max, step, format(v), track (your own track).

props.name: format
props.doc: Text of the value shown next to the slider.

props.name: showValue
props.doc: The value shown next to the slider: `false` removes it.

props.name: track
props.doc: Your own track under a drawn thumb, instead of the browser's: `true` (a ramp in the control's color), a class name (the track is yours: a gradient from your CSS) or a node drawn as the track. Thumb fill: `--m-slider-thumb`.

props.name: valueText
props.doc: Spoken value (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + " degrees"`.

props.name: onCommit
props.doc: Called once when a change is finished (pointer released, key pressed), after `onChange`.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Slider.tr: Geçerli değeri gösteren aralık kaydırıcısı. Prop'lar: min, max, step, format(v).

hadi-march/ui#sorter.name: sorter
hadi-march/ui#sorter.doc: Order helper shared with the palette: "alpha" (default, Intl.Collator of the active locale), "none", or a compare fn.
hadi-march/ui#sorter.signature: function sorter(sort: NavSort | undefined, loc?: string): ((a: { title: MaybeFn<string> }, b: { title: MaybeFn<string> }) => number) | null

returns.type: ((a: { title: MaybeFn<string> }, b: { title: MaybeFn<string> }) => number) | null

hadi-march/ui#sorter.tr: Paletle paylaşılan sıralama yardımcısı: "alpha" (varsayılan, etkin dilin Intl.Collator'ı), "none" ya da bir karşılaştırma işlevi.

hadi-march/ui#Spacer.name: Spacer
hadi-march/ui#Spacer.doc: Flexible gap in a row (pushes the following items to the end).
hadi-march/ui#Spacer.tr: Satırda esnek boşluk (sonraki öğeleri sona iter).

hadi-march/ui#Spinner.name: Spinner
hadi-march/ui#Spinner.doc: `<Spinner size="sm" label="Loading users" />`, `<Spinner decorative size="em" />` (inside a control that names the state itself).

props.name: size
props.doc: "sm" | "md" | "lg", or "em": the size and the colour of the text around it (inside a button, a line of text).

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Hidden from assistive technology: no role, no label (a text or a live region next to it already says it).

props.name: colors
props.doc: "brand", a list of color tokens, or "single" (one color in a multicolor theme).

props.name: color
props.doc: One theme color token ("brand-orange", "success"…): a one-colour ring in that colour.

hadi-march/ui#Spinner.tr: `<Spinner size="sm" label="Loading users" />` — döner yükleme göstergesi.

hadi-march/ui#Splitter.name: Splitter
hadi-march/ui#Splitter.doc: Two resizable panes (drag the handle, or the arrow keys / Home / End on it; Enter resets).

props.name: initial
props.doc: Initial share of the first pane, 0..1.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled share of the first pane (0..1); with `onChange` the parent owns it.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the new share while dragging or on the keyboard.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: "horizontal": panes side by side (default); "vertical": stacked.

props.name: min
props.doc: Smallest share of either pane (default 0.15).

props.name: handle
props.doc: The handle: true (default, a line), false (fixed panes with a plain divider), or your own grip drawn on the line.

hadi-march/ui#Splitter.tr: Yeniden boyutlandırılabilir iki bölme (tutamacı sürükleyin ya da üzerinde ok tuşları / Home / End; Enter sıfırlar).

hadi-march/ui#Stack.name: Stack
hadi-march/ui#Stack.doc: `<Stack gap={3} direction="row" align="center" justify="between" wrap>…</Stack>` (gap = token step 0–8)

props.name: gap
props.doc: Token step 0–8 (default 3).

hadi-march/ui#Stack.tr: `<Stack gap={3} direction="row" align="center" justify="between" wrap>…</Stack>` (gap = 0–8 belirteç adımı)

hadi-march/ui#StatusBar.name: StatusBar
hadi-march/ui#StatusBar.doc: `<StatusBar items={[{ id: "branch", icon: gitBranch, text: "main", onSelect: pick }, { id: "pos", side: "end", text: () => `Ln ${$line}` }]} />`

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the "…" menu (default "More status").

props.name: moreIcon
props.doc: Icon of the "…" menu button.

props.name: overflow
props.doc: false: no "…" menu; every item stays in the bar (default true).

props.name: dot
props.doc: The tone dot of items without an icon: true (default), false, or `(tone, item) => node` (tone is live).

props.name: pulse
props.doc: false: the dot of a busy item stays still (default true).

hadi-march/ui#StatusBar.tr: `<StatusBar items={[{ id: "branch", icon: gitBranch, text: "main", onSelect: pick }, { id: "pos", side: "end", text: () => `Ln ${$line}` }]} />` — durum çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#StatusDot.name: StatusDot

props.name: tone
props.doc: Meaning: neutral, primary, info, success (default), warn, danger.

props.name: pulse
props.doc: Motion: `true` / "ring" (a breathing ring), "blink" (the dot fades), `false` (default, still).

props.name: size
props.doc: xs · sm · md (default) · lg.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name ("Online"). Without it the dot is decorative.

props.name: hollow
props.doc: A ring instead of a filled dot (the point of a timeline entry): the ground shows through; children (an icon) sit inside.

props.name: children
props.doc: With `hollow`: a small mark inside the ring.

hadi-march/ui#StatusDot.tr: Tonlu ya da tema renkli küçük durum noktası; `pulse` ile nabız atar, `label` verilirse ekran okuyucu okur, verilmezse süstür: `<StatusDot tone="success" pulse label="Live" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Stepper.name: Stepper
hadi-march/ui#Stepper.doc: `<Stepper steps={[{ title: "Cart" }, …]} current={$i} onSelect={(i) => $i = i} panels={[<Cart/>, <Address/>, <Pay/>]} />`

props.name: current
props.doc: Current step (0-based).

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Called with the step to go to (a step click, Back / Next).

props.name: panels
props.doc: Content per step: a list, or a function of the index.

props.name: nav
props.doc: Show Back / Next buttons under the panel. Default: when there are panels and onSelect.

props.name: finishLabel
props.doc: Label of the last step's button. Default "Finish".

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Steps in a column beside the panel (live: the same stepper turns).

props.name: morph
props.doc: Morph between steps (default true): the highlight stretches and the panels blur into each other; false = at once.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: The liquid highlight around the current step (default true).

props.name: counter
props.type: boolean | ((i: number, n: number) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The "2 / 4" counter between Back and Next: true (default), false, or `(i, n) => content` (i is 0-based).

props.name: labels
props.type: { back?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; next?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; step?: ((i: number, n: number) => string) | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: the Back and Next buttons and the panel's accessible name (`step(i, n)`, i is 0-based).

props.name: doneIcon
props.doc: Passed to Steps: the mark of a done step (icon, string, or false to keep the number).

props.name: renderDot
props.type: ((i: number, state: "done" | "current" | "todo", step: StepItem) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Passed to Steps: your own dot content.

props.name: connector
props.doc: Passed to Steps: the line between the steps (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Stepper.tr: `<Stepper steps={[{ title: "Cart" }, …]} current={$i} onSelect={(i) => $i = i} panels={[<Cart/>, <Address/>, <Pay/>]} />` — adım adım gezinme.

hadi-march/ui#Steps.name: Steps
hadi-march/ui#Steps.doc: Progress through stages: `<Steps steps={[{ title: "Account" }, …]} current={$step} onSelect={(i) => $step = i} />`

props.name: doneIcon
props.doc: Mark of a done step: the check (default), your own icon (an IconDef or a short string), or false to keep the number / step icon.

props.name: renderDot
props.type: ((i: number, state: "done" | "current" | "todo", step: StepItem) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Your own dot content: `(i, state, step) => node` (replaces the number, the step icon and the check).

props.name: connector
props.doc: The line between the steps (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Steps.tr: Aşamalar boyunca ilerleme: `<Steps steps={[{ title: "Account" }, …]} current={$step} onSelect={(i) => $step = i} />`

hadi-march/ui#StoryProgress.name: StoryProgress

props.name: index
props.doc: Current segment (0-based).

props.name: duration
props.doc: Fill time of the current segment (ms). Default 6000.

props.name: run
props.doc: Restarts the current fill when it changes (the story id): the same index in another group starts over.

props.name: label
props.doc: Your own screen-reader text: `(index, count) => "…"` (index 0-based). Default "Story 2 of 5".

props.name: color
props.doc: Fill color. Default: white on the photo.

hadi-march/ui#StoryProgress.tr: `<StoryProgress count={items.length} index={$i} run={item.id} paused={$hold} onDone={next} />` — hikaye ilerleme çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#StoryRing.name: StoryRing
hadi-march/ui#StoryRing.doc: `<StoryRing name={u.name} src={u.avatar} state={u.seen ? "seen" : "new"} label={u.name} onClick={() => open(u)} />`

props.name: size
props.doc: sm 40 · md 58 · lg 88 px. Default md.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text under the ring (story tray).

props.name: add
props.doc: A small + badge (your own story: add one).

props.name: loading
props.doc: Turns the ring (stories are loading).

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Makes it a button.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Your own accessible name. Default: "HADİ, new story" / "HADİ, story seen" / the name.

props.name: addIcon
props.doc: Your own content for the + badge.

props.name: avatar
props.doc: Your own node instead of the Avatar (a logo, an image).

hadi-march/ui#StoryRing.tr: `<StoryRing name={u.name} src={u.avatar} state={u.seen ? "seen" : "new"} label={u.name} onClick={() => open(u)} />` — hikaye halkası.
